_comment: The 8 Secondary Task cards from the core box, transcribed from the printed English cards in the Tabletop Simulator mod, cross-checked against the Korean scans on namu.wiki. Each card's VP value is printed in its text and drawn again as that many VP tokens on the card face, so both were checked against each other. Card text here is our English rendering of the printed Korean; the printed card always wins.
_rules: Rulebook 5.2.3: during setup each player picks 1 Secondary Task, starting with the First Player, and scores it privately alongside the shared Main Task. Every setup step below happens in the Mission Preparation step.

cards.name: Behead
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: your opponent designates one of their own mechs as the "Head".
cards.scoring: Gain 5 Victory Points when the Head is Destroyed.

cards.name: Bounty Hunt
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: designate 1 Enemy Mech as the "Bounty".
cards.scoring: Gain 4 Victory Points when the Bounty is Destroyed.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.setup: No setup. This card needs no designated target.
cards.scoring: Gain 2 Victory Points for each Enemy Mech destroyed. Gain 1 Victory Point for each Enemy Drone destroyed.

cards.name: Escort
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: you designate one of your own mechs as the Escort Target.
cards.scoring: Gain 3 Victory Points if the Escortee has not been Destroyed by the End of the Game.

cards.name: Weapons Test
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: you designate one of your own mechs as the Test Unit.
cards.scoring: Gain 1 Victory Point each time the Test Unit destroys a Part or Drone.

cards.name: Planned Obsolescence
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: you designate one of your own mechs as the "Obsolete Mech".
cards.scoring: Gain 2 Victory Points when the Obsolete Mech is Destroyed.

cards.name: Mercy
cards.setup: No setup. This card needs no designated target.
cards.scoring: Gain 2 Victory Points if by the end of the game no Enemy Mechs were Destroyed. Enemy Mechs removed to Integrity Loss do not count.

cards.name: Excavation Claim
cards.setup: Mission Preparation: you designate one Tactical Zone as the Excavation Site.
cards.scoring: Gain 2 Victory Points if there are only Ally Units in the designated Tactical Area by the end of the Game. Low Value Units do not count.
